chatbot.title: Support Assistant
chatbot.greeting: Hello! I'm the CINEMA assistant. How can I help you?
chatbot.answerBooking: Choose a movie → showtime → seats → payment. Your e-ticket (QR code) will be in "Account → Booking History".
chatbot.answerShowtimes: Showtimes appear on each movie's detail page, grouped by format 2D/3D/IMAX/4DX.
chatbot.answerCancel: You can cancel a ticket while the order is still in "Pending Payment" status under Booking History.
chatbot.answerMembership: You earn 1 point per 10,000đ spent; your membership tier upgrades automatically with points. Enter a discount code at the payment step.
chatbot.answerNearby: Go to the "Theaters" page and tap "Find nearest theater" to sort by distance to you.
chatbot.answerPayment: We support domestic cards and e-wallets (MoMo / Apple Pay / Google Pay) at the payment step.
chatbot.answerCombo: You can add popcorn, drinks & combos right at the payment step, bundled into your order.
chatbot.fallback: I didn't quite get that. Try asking about: booking, showtimes, cancel/refund, membership, payment, or theaters near you.
